description.value: West End Ice Rink is a public ice rink located at 1750 Haro Street in Vancouver's West End neighbourhood, operated through the City of Vancouver Parks system in association with the West End Community Centre. Situated close to Stanley Park and the English Bay waterfront, it offers a skating experience in one of Vancouver's most cycle-friendly urban neighbourhoods. Touring cyclists passing through the seawall or West End routes may find it a worthwhile stop.
